title: Non-validated clients by KRAs (BSE)
purpose: BSE's monthly Non_Validated_Clients_by_KRAs file: the firm's clients whose KYC the KRAs have not validated. None of the exchanges' or the depository's circulars gives the file's columns: they are read by their header names, which this layout lists (add a header text here when the file's differs). The file is matched by PAN, then the client code.
linked: Matched with the clients on Compliance → KYC trading gate: each client on it is held back on the front ends until the KRA verifies the KYC and a later list no longer has the client.
source: BSE notice 20251111-43 and its monthly successors (latest 20261109-28), requirements 1-2. The columns are not published: read by header names.
